name: Midnight Paws - After-Hours VOIP Lead Triage

nodes.name: VOIP Intake Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point for all VOIP system events. Accepts POST requests from the VOIP provider (simulated). Expected fields: caller_id (required), caller_name (optional), timestamp (ISO 8601, required), voicemail_url (optional), call_type (optional: missed_call | voicemail). Data arrives under $json.body. Produces raw VOIP payload for downstream processing.

nodes.name: Time-Based Logic
nodes.notes: Determines shift_status from the incoming timestamp. Converts the ISO 8601 timestamp to America/Los_Angeles time using Luxon DateTime (built into n8n). Active Grooming Hours = 20:00–03:59 (spans midnight, so localHour >= 20 OR localHour < 4). Admin Hours = 04:00–19:59. Outputs enriched item with shift_status ('After-hours' or 'Daytime'), local_hour_la, caller fields, and booking_calendar_url.

nodes.name: Route by Shift
nodes.notes: Branches on shift_status. True output (index 0) = 'After-hours' → groomer-is-busy message. False output (index 1) = 'Daytime' → admin-team message. Both branches converge at the Google Sheets append node to maintain a single log regardless of shift.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value: ={{ 'Hi! This is Midnight Paws Grooming. Our groomer is currently with a reactive pet and cannot interrupt the session. We\'ll call you back at the next safe break. In the meantime, you can book directly here: ' + $json.booking_calendar_url }}

nodes.name: Send After-Hours SMS
nodes.notes: Sends the after-hours automated SMS reply via Twilio REST API. Fires only when shift_status = 'After-hours'. Message text: groomer is with reactive pet, will call back at safe break, booking link appended. Credential is Twilio Account SID (username) + Auth Token (password) as HTTP Basic Auth. Replace credential ID after import.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value: ={{ 'Hi! Thanks for calling Midnight Paws Grooming. Our admin team will return your call shortly. You can also book here: ' + $json.booking_calendar_url }}

nodes.name: Send Daytime SMS
nodes.notes: Sends the daytime automated SMS reply via Twilio REST API. Fires only when shift_status = 'Daytime'. Message text: admin team will return call, booking link appended. Same Twilio credential as After-Hours SMS. Replace credential ID after import.

nodes.name: Log to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Single convergence point for both branches. Appends one row to the 'Lead Log' sheet regardless of shift_status. Columns: caller_id, caller_name, call_timestamp, shift_status, response_sent, booking_url, logged_at. Both the After-hours SMS node and the Daytime SMS node connect here. Replace spreadsheetId and credential ID after import.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'ok', message: 'Lead received and logged.', caller_id: $json.caller_id || 'unknown', shift_status: $json.shift_status || 'unknown', logged_at: $json.logged_at || new Date().toISOString() }) }}

nodes.name: Acknowledge VOIP System
nodes.notes: Closes the HTTP response loop by returning a 200 JSON acknowledgment to the VOIP system. Must be the terminal node for the responseMode: responseNode webhook. Returns caller_id, shift_status, and logged_at so the VOIP platform can confirm receipt. Both branches converge at Sheets first, then here.
